description: This file defines API endpoints related to user progress tracking in a gym management system, including creating and listing exercise logs and body metrics. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database interactions, handling RBAC permissions for members, trainers, and admins.

methods.name: str _resolve_target_user_id( current_user: dict, target_user_id: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Helper function for RBAC, determining the target user ID based on current user's role and provided target_user_id. Ensures proper access control logic for members, trainers, and admins.

methods.description: API endpoint to create a new exercise log for the authenticated user or a specified target user (by trainer/admin). Handles permission checks to ensure members can only create logs for themselves.

methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve exercise logs for the current or specified user, with filtering options. Enforces permission checks so members can only view their own logs.
